name: marvosa
description: Talk to a live pure-integer AI organism: zero floats, memory as one alpha-tagged line.
long_description: Marvosa is a complete artificial organism built entirely on the HCL pure-integer substrate (GUHCT framework): zero floats, zero imported constants, and its entire memory persisted as one alpha-tagged line. Five tools: talk (converse with the organism), reason (exact HCL arithmetic), integrity (alpha self-check, alpha^-1 = 137), memory_line (its identity line), braid_word (its experience record).

tools.name: talk
tools.description: Send a message to the organism; returns answer, reasoning trace, and integrity report

tools.name: memory_line
tools.description: Read the organism's one alpha-tagged holographic memory expression

tools.name: integrity
tools.description: Alpha integrity check across all engines (alpha^-1 = 137, intact flag)

tools.name: braid_word
tools.description: Retrieve the current braid word (the organism's experience record)

tools.name: reason
tools.description: Evaluate a pure-integer equation with optional variable bindings
